Name: Brother Matthew
Description: A warm presence, Brother Matthew is the Abbey’s preacher and usually found holding a sermon for the locals and fellow monks.
AuditionLineA: Good people of the Abbey. Take a moment to listen, for I have much to say.
AuditionLineB: Greetings, friend. I don't think I have seen you around here before. My name is Brother Matthew and I help spread the word about the importance of preserving the knowledge of the old ones.
AuditionLineC: The Abbey is home to anyone, so long as they don't cause trouble. We are an independent community and rarely get visitors, such as yourself.

Name: Peterson
Description: Mr. Peterson is a young man who owns a small farm near the Abbey’s cathedral.
AuditionLineA: Hello, friend. Haven't seen you around here before. First time to the Abbey?
AuditionLineB: Let me tell ya, the Abbey might not be as flashy as New Reno, or as advanced as Vault City, but as far as I'm concerned, this place is about as good as it gets in the wastes.
AuditionLineC: Sorry pal, I've never heard of it. But if it has to do with pre-war times, then I bet there's something about it in the monastery's computers.

Name: Morlis
Description: Old and bitter, Morlis is The Chosen One’s aunt who never had much affection for them.
AuditionLineA: Why do you bother me, nephew? Can't you see I'm busy?
AuditionLineB: He said what? Out with it, child!
AuditionLineC: Well, here you are again. Have you once again failed to complete your quest?

Name: Brother Paul
Description: Appointed to the conservation of knowledge by digitally transcribing books, Brother Paul is aware of the Abbey’s laws regarding studying the old world but often finds himself reading them in secret. He’s particularly fond of botany books.
AuditionLineA: I can't express to you the tedium of having to back up all these files each and every day. There's just so much information to preserve, but, of course, it must be done.
AuditionLineB: The Abbot is a good spiritual leader, but he's been a little cranky since we lost Brother Thomas to the beast.
AuditionLineC: Did you know a notch in a tree will remain the same distance from the ground as the tree grows?

Name: Chrissy
Description: A young member of the Squatters, Chrissy is being held captive by the New Khans after she accidentally discovered the entrance to their base. A lot tougher than she looks, she won’t hesitate to defend herself.
AuditionLineA: Let me guess. The guys are tired of me kicking them where it hurts, so they sent you in here.
AuditionLineB: A bow tie?  It's like a scarf, but for men. Now, just imagine me kicking you SO hard that you end up wearing your dangly about your neck. Get it?
AuditionLineC: My knight in shining armor returns. Well, it would shine if you'd clean it every once in a while.

Name: Dalia
Description: Same NPC as the other Dalia row — she relocates from the New Khans camp (Vault 15) to Vault 13.

Name: Dalia
Description: Same NPC as the other Dalia row — she starts in the New Khans camp (Vault 15) and relocates here to Vault 13.

Name: Darion
Description: Darion is the leader of the New Khans raiders. His band is a derivative of The Great Khans of which he is the only survivor after The Chosen One’s ancestor, the Vault Dweller, wiped them out while rescuing a young President Tandi. He now lives in fear inside of Vault 15, ready to incinerate any trespassers with his flame thrower. He has a dog called "Baddog".
AuditionLineA: So, here you are at last. The savior of the downtrodden, the righter of wrongs, the icon of hope for humanity. What a dumb-ass!
AuditionLineB: Well, before you start any boring speeches, I'd just like to say that I'm not fucking interested.
AuditionLineC: Let's just cut to the chase and get this over with. Baddog, kill!

Name: Doc Jones
Description: Doc Jones works for the New Khans of Vault 15, albeit against his will. Serving as the personal doctor for Darion, he is privy to many of the New Khans' leader's personality disorders and eccentricities.
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Doc Jones. You can call me Doc. What can I help you with?
AuditionLineB: Darion is a mental case, plain and simple. He's got more spooks in his head than his dog has fleas.
AuditionLineC: Here, you'll need to drink this -- all of it, I know it tastes foul. Now, just lie down on the bed over there, and I'll wake you in the morning.

Name: Rebecca
Description: An older member of the Squatters, Rebecca is the mother of Chrissy whom she loves dearly and is worried about her recent disappearance. Like many members of her “tribe” she is wary of strangers.
AuditionLineA: Hi, I'm Rebecca. Can we talk privately, please?
AuditionLineB: You may think I'm crazy but I get the feeling I'm being watched all the time.
AuditionLineC: I have a daughter named Chrissy who's a bit of a tomboy. She likes to run around, explore, and pretty much stick her nose into things. Chrissy's a good kid, though.

Name: Zeke
Description: Zeke is the elderly leader of the Vault 15 Squatters (a group of wanderers and vagrants). He will do anything to protect his people, even strike deals with less than agreeable individuals.
AuditionLineA: My name's Zeke, stranger. I'm sorry, but I don't have time to talk to you -- and I don't think there's anything in this town for you, anyway. You should move on.
AuditionLineB: Why don't you take a hint and get the duck out of fodge?
AuditionLineC: They have the guns, they control the water, and they control the food. That means they are in charge. Period.

Name: Chris
Description: Chris is an old man who is the sentry and overwatch radioman at the Navarro gas station, posing as a gas station attendant. His role is to dissuade travellers from proceeding ahead towards the base, as well as receiving fresh recruits from other Enclave bases in the area of operation.
AuditionLineA: This here's my place, Chris's. It's a service station - ain't you ever seen one of those, in old magazines and such? That's what I got here - a service station.
AuditionLineB: Navarro? Ain't heard that name in ages. Old military base southeast of San Fran, and that's a ways south of here
AuditionLineC: Alert! We got an intruder at the station! Alert!

Name: Navarro Base Commander
Description: A military man through-and-through, the Navarro base commander has very little patience with unruly subordinates and is very quick to dismiss them – or worse.
AuditionLineA: I don’t have time to chitchat with the grunts. You’re dismissed.
AuditionLineB: Make it quick soldier, I don’t have all day to stand around.
AuditionLineC: Wrong answer, maggot. You’re to carry your papers with you at all times. You should know that!

Name: Quartermaster
Description: Navarro’s Quartermaster is a pretty easy-going fellow with close relations to the base's drill sergeant, Arch Dornan. He has a brother with stunted mental development serving in the Enclave Armed Forces.
AuditionLineA: You the guy Arch radioed about?
AuditionLineB: This base is on alert and I don't recognize you. Show me your papers, soldier.
AuditionLineC: What the... I can see why you're here. You obviously want to get rid of that antique suit you're wearing.

Name: Quincy
Description: Head of Navarro’s technical crew, Quincy is a responsible man who takes his job very seriously. He has a short temper towards people he deems incompetent. He is rivals with Raul, Navarro’s lead Vertibird mechanic.
AuditionLineA: Name's Quincy, soldier. Why are you tapping my shoulder and looking lost?
AuditionLineB: You're one round short of a full clip, aren't you? Well, they call you grunts for a reason. Look, Einstein, I can't give you the plans without authorization, okay?
AuditionLineC: Damn it! You know, Raul would lose his head if it weren't placed so firmly up his ass! This is the third time this quarter that he's lost those plans!

Name: Raul
Description: Raul is Navarro's premier Vertibird mechanic. He has a characteristic attitude, speaking about himself in third person and an unhealthy obsession about keeping Vertibirds in top shape. He has a heated rivalry with Quincy, Navarro’s head of the technical crew.
AuditionLineA: Sorry, man, but I don't have time to chit-chat, you know? I got to get this bird working.
AuditionLineB: Hey man, Raul don't take no shit from nobody. You see Quincy working on these birds? No way, man. Only Raul works on these babies. You know why? Cause Quincy don't know DICK, man, that's why!
AuditionLineC: Hey, thanks, man. Raul owes you one! Don't go away and, hey, man, if anybody screws with Raul's birds, you shoot them in the ass. Ok?

Name: Great Ananias
Description: Ananias is a short, mustachioed man with a somewhat criminal look about him. He is a self-proclaimed magician that claims to have found a great "jan-u-wine" (genuine) mummy and to have a haunted house next door. He charges money ($25) for seeing the mummy, of course. In fact, the "mummy" is a sleeping, comatose ghoul named Woody. The haunted house has more basis in fact: Anna Winslow's ghost recently has become restless because her locket was stolen from the haunted house by Joey, a local thug and Jet dealer.
AuditionLineA: Hello, welcome, salutations! I am the Great Ananias (he offers you a slight bow, with a flourish). I bring mysteries from near and far friend. Mysteries from a world beyond our own... of the Netherworld.
AuditionLineB: No, my friend, a MUMMY! Straight from the sands of ancient Egypt to the sands of the Wastes! Exclusively for you to see!

Name: Anna Winslow
Description: Late at night in an old ruined building, The Chosen One can find Anna Winslow, a wandering spirit. Her speech is incoherent but she seems concerned about a certain “locket”.
AuditionLineA: Oh, the pain! It burns so!
AuditionLineB: Where is it? I cannot find it! I am lost! Oh....
AuditionLineC: It's so bright…

Name: Flick
Description: A shady character with an Italian accent, Flick fancies himself a philanthropist, helping the impoverished children of the Den by putting them to work as pickpocketers in return for some shelter and food.
AuditionLineA: I'm a fuckin' provider, waddya think? I'm like a good Samurai-itan guy
AuditionLineB: What you talkin' about? You think I'm a fucking stupid pirla? Some dumb filio di puttana? You think I'm some kinda clown? Am I here to amuse you, is that it?
AuditionLineC: I provide fer them little paisanos. Pai-san-o, you know, the kids. My kids.

Name: Frankie
Description: Frankie is the short-tempered owner of “The Hole”, a bar on the eastern side of The Den. He has a heated rivalry with Rebecca Dyer and her establishment, although it’s more one sided than he thinks.
AuditionLineA: I'm Frankie and yer standing in 'The Hole.' Best damn bar for a hundred miles!
AuditionLineB: I don't want people like you in my place. Get out!
AuditionLineC: Go talk to Sheila. Hey, Sheila, you got a customer!

Name: Lara
Description: Leader of a small gang and subordinate to Metzger, Lara is cunning and calculative. She's a rival to Tyler, another local gang leader. The Chosen can turn the tides in her favour.
AuditionLineA: The name's Lara; I run this gang. You better not be here to cause trouble or you're in for a world of hurt.
AuditionLineB: If you didn't come to The Den for a specific reason you should probably leave. It's not very safe around here.
AuditionLineC: Coward!

Name: Metzger
Description: Ruthless and borderline psychotic, Metzger is the feared leader of the Slaver’s Guild chapter in The Den. If they are so inclined, The Chosen can work for him.
AuditionLineA: What the fuck do you want? This is the Slaver's Guild not some safe house for you fucking jet heads.
AuditionLineB: So, our delicate little flower girl returns, you changed your mind then?
AuditionLineC: You here to work for a fucking change?

Name: Rebecca Dyer
Description: Easy on the eyes, Rebecca is the owner of “Becky’s”, the local bar and casino. Despite being a ruthless businesswoman, she’s one of the few upstanding citizens of The Den.
AuditionLineA: Hey! You want a drink or did you just come back to say hi?
AuditionLineB: Well, since you're such a good customer, I'll let you in on a little secret.
AuditionLineC: Whiskey is my specialty. It's almost a tradition in the Dyer family. I charge the low, low price of only $5

Name: Sheila
Description: Bored and disinterested, Sheila is a sell body working at “The Hole”. She has little patience for small talk.
AuditionLineA: Whatever…
AuditionLineB: I don't get paid enough for this.
AuditionLineC: Hey, it’ll cost more if you've got an audience with ya.

Name: Tubby
Description: Tubby is the sleazy owner of “Tubby’s”, a weapon and chem shop in The Den.
AuditionLineA: Hello, sir, and welcome to Tubby's. I am the proprietor. May I help you?
AuditionLineB: Only the strongest, fastest or smartest will survive here. I'm sure you will find your niche.
AuditionLineC: Oh my. I can tell we will have a communication problem. Please nod if you would like to trade any goods.

Name: Vic
Description: A crafty trader and repairman, Vic is a friendly but slightly naive individual who’s currently being held captive by slavers. He has the habit of calling everyone “Boss”.
AuditionLineA: Okay, Boss!
AuditionLineB: Metzger's still quite upset with me, even though we fixed his darn radio. He's threatening to sell me off! I'll do anything you ask if you can get me out of this mess.
AuditionLineC: Sure, I'll join up with you! This old fart has one big adventure left in him.

Name: Arthur Pendragon
Description: Born to a father by the name of Uther, Arthur has been with the Brotherhood of Steel searching for the Holy Hand Grenade for a long time.
AuditionLineA: Hail, travelers. My name is Arthur, son of Uther Pendragon, from the Brotherhood of Steel. We are on quest for the Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch. Hast thou seen it?
AuditionLineB: The Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch? Why, 'tis only the greatest hand held, anti-personnel weapon of its kind.
AuditionLineC: Bloody peasant!

Name: Bridge Keeper
Description: The Bridge Keeper is a wild-eyed man with an unkempt beard, a raspy voice, and an oddly, smelly, filthy brown and purple garment made out of special fabrics. His main purpose is to guard a bridge and tell riddles to unsuspecting travellers, if they fail to answer correctly they inexplicably explode into many tiny pieces.
AuditionLineA: Stop! Who would cross the Bridge of Death must answer me these questions three, 'ere the other side he see.
AuditionLineB: How much weight can a person with a strength of six carry assuming he has the Strong Back perk?
AuditionLineC: Right. Off you go.

Name: Dogmeat
Description: A fan favourite who needs little introduction, Dogmeat is the eternally loyal companion to The Chosen One and his ancestor.
AuditionLineA: Awooooooooooo!
AuditionLineB: Grrrrrr!
AuditionLineC: Woof!

Name: Kaga
Description: Once one of Arroyo’s greatest warriors, Kaga’s soul was corrupted by outside influences turning him into a wicked man. He was banished by the tribe and now seeks revenge by attacking the Chosen One any chance he gets as he believes the title should be his. He likes talking in the third person.
AuditionLineA: So, they cast out Kaga, then deem YOU the Chosen One? Ha!
AuditionLineB: You think you are better than I, Kaga the Great?!
AuditionLineC: Kaga won't even bother speaking with you further. Prepare to die at the hands of Kaga!

Name: Kitsune
Description: As dangerous as she is beautiful, Kitsune was a Chinese spy during Pre-War times. She may have more secrets to hide. The Chosen One awakes her after she was cryogenically frozen in a Pre-War research facility.
AuditionLineA: Is it over? The War…Who won?
AuditionLineB: What do you do when you've been hibernating for over a century? Even bears don't sleep that long.
AuditionLineC: Maybe... maybe I will take my chances with you.

Name: Badger
Description: Well liked by his peers, Badger is the hacker and “information retriever” for the Tanker Vagrants. A good natured individual and burping enthusiast, he likes to bring up how he used to play in a band.
AuditionLineA: *Loud Belch* Whaddya want?
AuditionLineB: I'm Badger. I used to have a band. *sigh* Called ourselves “There We Smolder”. Now I'm the resident computer tech in San Fran.
AuditionLineC: Thank you, thank you, thank you. I can't thank you enough for saving her.

Name: Chip
Description: Usually cheerful fellow, Chip of Tanker Vagrants is less so due to him losing his spleen in a bet.
AuditionLineA: Ooh, my guts... ow, ow, ow.
AuditionLineB: Piss off.
AuditionLineC: Dude, I heard you found my spleen. Did you know to talk to Dr. Fung about putting it back in me?

Name: Dr. Fung
Description: An old man with a wizened appearance, Dr. Fung is The Shi’s resident physician and one the best in the wasteland as he is capable of replacing organs, implanting battle armor plating and performing general healing.
AuditionLineA: Who am I? I am Dr. Fung. I teach and I heal.
AuditionLineB: You're hurt? Tsk, tsk. Ancient remedy will cure that.
AuditionLineC: This is a major operation. It will cost you your "good looks", a set of combat armor, and $49000. Are you willing to invest in this?

Name: Wong Yi Tze
Description: Short, rotund and jovial Dr. Wong is a welcome contrast to many of his fellow Shi scientists. He’s the lead researcher of his faction whose knowledge in machinery and computers is second to none.
AuditionLineA: Oh, hello there!
AuditionLineB: Ahh, yes! Indeed. I will prepare it with fava beans and a nice chianti.
AuditionLineC: Ah, but if I tell you our plans, then everyone will know. I'm afraid they are secret plans, for now.

Name: Vikki Goldman & Juan Cruz
Description: Popular pornstars in New Reno, Vikki and Juan are an eerily wholesome couple whose goal is to sway potential recruits into Hubology using their looks and status as celebrities.
AuditionLineA: Him: Hi! I'm Juan Cruz! Her: And I'm Vikki Goldman! Both: We're celebrities! And we endorse Hubology! Both: Please note that any similarities between us and people or institutions, living or dead, is entirely coincidental.
AuditionLineB: Her: That wasn't so bad, was it? Him: Now just go talk to AHS-7 and we'll be comrades in Hubology! Her: I'm so excited!
AuditionLineC: Her: Oh, yes, you should definitely make your own choices. Him: And with the Hub's latest book, you can learn how to make the RIGHT choice!

Name: Lo Pan
Description: Dragon’s (a San Fran martial arts master) eternal rival, Lo Pan is the ying to his yang. While the latter preaches about honour and justice, Lo Pan has no quarrels about committing crimes to get results. He seeks to finally end his rivalry with Dragon.
AuditionLineA: Him? The Dragon. He's a weakling who fosters weakness.
AuditionLineB: Teach you? I don't think so. You look far too self-righteous. Get out of here.
AuditionLineC: I may be a scumbag, but never will it be said I don't stand up for my people. I'm going to hurt you before you die.

Name: AHS-7
Description: AHS-9’s second in command, AHS-7 is a devoted follower of the cult. He greets newcomers and indoctrinates them in the Hubologists' ways.
AuditionLineA: Ah, poor child. Would you like to be aligned?
AuditionLineB: Do not wait too long before returning with a reply. Your neurodynes will be filled with more and more pollution until we can begin the cleansing process.
AuditionLineC: Torch us? TORCH US? GUARDS! KILL THE UNBELIEVER!

Name: Suze
Description: Suze is Badger’s timid girlfriend and a begrudging member of the Tanker Vagrants.
AuditionLineA: Aieee! Help me!
AuditionLineB: Oh, you poor dear. Radiation and the wasteland aren't nice, are they? I hope someone can help you.
AuditionLineC: I used to be a nanny, but then the kids mutated into monsters.

Name: Hank
Description: Hank is a glowing one with a concerned look on his face. In charge of maintaining the reactor and ensuring it works properly, Hank is approachable and courteous for a wastelander. He is quite talented in technical matters, but leaves major repairs and part swaps to the resident tech wizard, Festus.
AuditionLineA: Heh, heh. I wouldn’t advise that, smoothy. You’d fry into a crisp. Me, I like the warmth, but I wouldn’t recommend it for you. Quite a bit of heat and radiation in there. That’s why the smoothies that built this place included a maintenance bot.

Name: Lenny
Description: The shy but kind doctor of Gecko, Lenny is a ghoul hoping to join the Chosen One in his adventures. Where he lacks in combat skills he makes up with his big heart.
AuditionLineA: Hello there, my name’s Lenny. H’how can I h’help you?
AuditionLineB: Y’you c’could say that. I’d trade in all those years to b’be a n’normal person again.
AuditionLineC: You d’didn’t have enough m’money... b’but I helped y’you out anyway. J’jist c’cant stand to see p’people in p’pain.

Name: Skeeter
Description: Skeeter is an inventor and resident mechanic of Gecko, a small town and haven for Ghouls (heavily mutated humans). He’s very smart but quite scatterbrained and tends to cause fires around town while testing his many “inventions”.
AuditionLineA: Most amateur mechanics jist assume that it’s the battery itself. But you know what ass-uming things does, dontcha?
AuditionLineB: Mostly I jist sorta tinker with things. Take ‘em apart an try to put ‘em all back t’gether… mostly. Make ‘em work better… sometimes.
AuditionLineC: Thanks for fixin’ up our atomic reactor. It shore needed some work. I woulda show’d ‘em how, but they don’t trust me in there any more.

Name: Zomak The Destroyer
Description: Zomak is a large and intimidating ghoul, he protects the leader of his cult (The Brain) with his life.
AuditionLineA: Renew, comrade! What are you doing here? State your business to Zomak the Destroyer.
AuditionLineB: Yes, the sacred talisman of Renewal. Renew, comrade! Renew!
AuditionLineC: Get out of here. The Brain doesn't have time for the likes of you.

Name: Chad
Description: Broken Hill’s Caravan Master, Chad is a lean but tough wastelander who’s led many convoy runs across California. He tends to smile insincerely as if he’s hiding something.
AuditionLineA: Howdy, friend! What can I do for you?
AuditionLineB: Probably a hell of a lot more exciting than what you do with your life, jerkoff.
AuditionLineC: What the hell are you doin’ here?

Name: Dan
Description: He is an inhabitant of Broken Hills. He also had a wife who hated mutants and ghouls. However, she got lost and he is looking for her.
AuditionLineA: Who are you? What are you doing in my house?
AuditionLineB: The reason I ask, you see, is because my wife is missing. I don't know where she is. She's been gone for days. I've asked around town, and no one has seen her. Can you find her for me?
AuditionLineC: You don't mean to say that my life is in danger too? Oh dear. You may be right. I've been hearing noises outside the house at night. Whispers and shuffles.

Name: Doc Holliday
Description: Witty but sickly, Doc Holliday is the resident physician of Broken Hills. He always enjoys chatting with his patients, especially about the “good ol’ times”.
AuditionLineA: ::wheeze:: Hi there. I'm Doc Holliday. How can I help you?
AuditionLineB: That looks like it must have hurt. Going to hurt your wallet, too...
AuditionLineC: What do I do here? You're in a hospital. I'm wearing a doctor's coat. I'm covered with blood. There are sharp, pointy things lying all around. Either I'm a successful killer or a fair doctor. Take your pick.

Name: Eric
Description: Eric is a greasy, sweating man. For some odd reason, his body exudes fly nutrients, causing flies to swarm around him whenever he sweats.
AuditionLineA: Sorry. I'm just a little on edge. All these damn flies and no air conditioning. If I just had a little more power I'd be able to shake 'em... but I don't.

Name: Francis
Description: Francis is an old and bored Supermutant in the town of Broken Hills, a community where humans, ghouls and mutants live in harmony. He usually spends his days challenging unsuspecting strangers into arm wrestling matches. There may be a darker side to him.
AuditionLineA: You think you can take me, eh? All right. You win, you get this power fist. I win, and you're my gimp for a night.
AuditionLineB: I've heard about you. I don't associate with scum.
AuditionLineC: Too bad we didn't crush your village when we controlled the wasteland. Get out of my sight, worm.

Name: Seymour
Description: Inside one of Broken Hills cornfields, The Chosen One can find Seymour the intelligent talking spore plant. He’s a lot more eloquent than he looks.
AuditionLineA: Hi! Nice weather we've been having, huh?
AuditionLineB: Very astute, friend, very astute. I can see you didn't germinate yesterday!
AuditionLineC: If you should happen to change your mind, you know where to find me. I've put down roots here. Ha ha ha! Just a little plant humor for you.

Name: Zaius
Description: Zaius is an old and tough supermutant in charge of the Broken Hills uranium mine. A no-nonsense individual, he prefers getting straight to the point.
AuditionLineA: Right. Well, I'm Zaius. Now that we're introduced You any good with your hands?
AuditionLineB: That's me. Smart guy. What's your problem?
AuditionLineC: Well, I'm sorry, Mr. High and Mighty, but I think that the town's survival might be a little more important. Hurry it up, will you?

Name: Aldo
Description: Aldo is a sickly man who wears very dirty robes. He is the Klamath's town greeter. He certainly knows lots about the town, but he will only tell the Chosen One about it once given some money. According to Aldo's dialogue, he is often drunk and uses the money he rakes in from greetings to buy more alcohol 'for his throat.'
AuditionLineA: Hello there, I haven’t seen you in Klamath before. I’m Aldo, the town greeter. (hic) It’s my job to greet anyone new in town and to answer any questions they might have about our bucolic little burg. Welcome to Klamath. (hic) Who might you be?
AuditionLineB: Thanks for the money, friend. (urp) I’m going to use it to get some (hic) medicine for my dry throat. Consider yourself officially (hic) greeted to the town of Klamath. Do you have any questions about our fair (urp) metropolis?
AuditionLineC: Here in Klamath some people farm, some raise brahmin, but trapping geckos is what most of the people do.

Name: Ardin Buckner
Description: A popular figure in Klamath, Ardin is the tired but fit owner of the town’s local store and motel. She’s usually friendly and outgoing but recent events have taken a toll on her.
AuditionLineA: You better not be planning any mischief here. What do you want?
AuditionLineB: I shouldn’t have let him go. He’s two weeks later getting back than he said he’d be and I’m worried.
AuditionLineC: Thank you for promising to look for my boy. I sure hope you can find him. I’m so worried about him. Hurry, please.

Name:
Chuck Dunton
Buck Dunton
Description: Tall and heavily muscled, Chuck is identical to his brother Buck, to the point of using exactly the same phrases and mannerisms. They are Klamath’s resident bullies who spend their days causing trouble and drinking in the local pub.
AuditionLineA: You just better push off, or my brother and I are going to pound your little head into jam.
AuditionLineB: You worthless sack of gecko shit! Just what the hell are doing in our sight again?
AuditionLineC: OK - here's the $50 and a little something extra for you, as well. A few sticks of Dunton's Drymeat.

Name: Jenny
Description: Jenny is the sultry but tired bathhouse worker in Klamath. Despite her busy schedule she always has time for a chat.
AuditionLineA: Gee, mister, that was pretty quick. You must be pretty new at this sort of thing.
AuditionLineB: He always had extra money to blow, at least when he worked he did. See, he specialised in really old stuff. You know, technical thingies
AuditionLineC: The Den is a hive of scum and villainy southeast of here. I guess about a week or so?

Name: Maida Buckner
Description: Maida is the young and brash daughter of Ardin Buckner, she’s cold and condescending, always ready to chastise someone she doesn't deem hard working.
AuditionLineA: Tribals, humph! (mutter, mutter) ...shiftless, worthless, lazy…
AuditionLineB: Questions, huh? Well get on with it, then. Talking to you doesn’t get my work any closer to being finished.
AuditionLineC: The only way I know to create a Garden of Eden is through plain old hard work.

Name: Sajag
Description: A short swarthy man with a perpetual smile on his face, Sajag is a rather shifty character with contacts in the Den, which enable him to offer a greater range of goods than any other seller in the town. He is also highly persuasive, which, combined with his preference for deception, is well exploited to further develop his business.
AuditionLineA: Hello there, stranger. Welcome to the Golden Gecko Tavern, Hotel, and Trading Post. I’m Sajag; I run the place. What can I get for you?
AuditionLineB: You’re our kind of people. You came to the right tavern to spend your money. What can I do for you, pal?
AuditionLineC: Well, Bob’s getting in the way of certain business partners. I don’t mind the competition. (grins) But they sure do. I’ll pay $50 to a smart cookie that can tell me where the still is. No other action required. (smiles)

Name: Sally Dunton
Description: “Big Nose” Sally Dunton runs Klamath’s bath house (and brothel), she's a shrewd woman who always puts business first.
AuditionLineA: My name's Sally Dunton, but mostly they call me Big Nose Sally. I'm the owner of this here bathhouse. We have a whole hassleful of special, attended baths for you to pick from.
AuditionLineB: Well, that's a right nice try for an idjit. But I ain't having none of your kind in here. Now, git out. Shoo, shoo.
AuditionLineC: You could use a bit of real scrubbing; don't you tribals know about soap? Oh well, that'll cost you $70.

Name: Torr Buckner
Description: Torr is Ardin’s son and Klamath’s very own village idiot. He’s an imposing man albeit quite “slow”, he has a kind heart and he’ll do anything to protect his “moo-moos”. If the Chosen One shares a similar intellect, their conversations will be quite “different”.
AuditionLineA: Bugmen take moo-moos at night. Torr scared! Help Torr?
AuditionLineB: Torr thank. Bugmen bad, no let bugmen eat moo-moos!
AuditionLineC: Torr good. No hurt Torr…

Name: Cornelius
Description: Cornelius is Rose’s wife and co-owner of Modoc’s Bed and Breakfast. He seems to have a form of senile dementia, and it is hard to obtain any information from him as "certain phrases seem to set him off".
AuditionLineA: Welcome to Rose's Bed and Breakfast. My name is Rose -- I mean, Cornelius -- and I run this bed and breakfast.
AuditionLineB: A while back, I forget when... my best friend of 30… or was it 40 years? Oh, it doesn’t matter, what matters is that he stole my precious gold pocket watch.
AuditionLineC: Pog? Whatever happened to that game, anyway? Well, I have to go. Maybe we can play later.

Name: Davin
Description: Handsome but dumb, Davin is the outgoing brother of Miria. He also may turn out to be a companion/burden to the Chosen One.
AuditionLineA: It's a lie. I only go out to the barn at night to a... make sure everything is locked up.
AuditionLineB: Wow, I never thought such a beautiful woman would try to seduce me. What! You're not a woman!
AuditionLineC: Dad runs the slaughterhouse. He's OK as far as fathers go.

Name: Farrel
Description: Farrel is Cornelius's best friend for 30 or 40 years, he is easily irritable and won’t think twice about defending his property.
AuditionLineA: Now what!?
AuditionLineB: Thank you! You are truly a hero amongst heroes. Not many people would risk their lives for a total stranger.
AuditionLineC: HA! If you think I'm so guilty, why don't you just shoot me and get it over with. You little punk, come and get me!

Name: Grisham
Description: Being the owner of Modoc's slaughterhouse, Grisham is still very active at his age. He’s father to Davin and Miria, two potential companions (and burdens) to The Chosen One.
AuditionLineA: The name's Grisham. Welcome to my slaughterhouse. You dropping off or picking up?
AuditionLineB: Smart as whip! You remind me of myself when I was young.
AuditionLineC: Why, that's a fine looking animal you have there. Should make some fine jerky.

Name: Jo
Description: The de facto leader of the farming village of Modoc, Jo aims to lead his people through a devastating drought that recently struck his town. He intends to do so by any means necessary, including tricking unsuspecting travellers to do his bidding.
AuditionLineA: Oh, you must be new around here. Welcome to Modoc. My name's Jo, I run the trading post here at Modoc.
AuditionLineB: A rain dance? [He chuckles softly] No, no... of course not. I wouldn't ask you to do something as impossible as that. You really can't make it rain, can you... No, of course you can't!
AuditionLineC: Those monsters, they're stealing our children. We won't be safe until they're all dead.

Name: Laddie
Description: A smart and astute animal, Laddie is Balthas and Jonny’s dog.
AuditionLineA: Grrr..
AuditionLineB: Woof Woof!
AuditionLineC: *Pant* *pant*!

Name: Rose
Description: Rose is the talented cook of Modoc’s Bed and Breakfast, there may be a secret behind her giant omelettes.
AuditionLineA: Welcome to Rose's Bed and Breakfast. My, aren't you the strapping young man. What can Rose help you with today?
AuditionLineB: When was the last time you had a good meal, young lady?
AuditionLineC: Oh, it's no secret. You just dip them in batter, add some salt and fry in grease.

Name: Vegeir
Description: Vegeir is the stoic leader of The Slags, a tribe of undergrounders and mutants who avoid the sun. He may be more reasonable than his appearance otherwise suggests.
AuditionLineA: A visitor - how convenient. I've been contemplating on a way to make contact with the surfacers, but now I don't have to worry about that -- thanks to your timely arrival.
AuditionLineB: You will go IF and WHEN I decide you can go. Not before.
AuditionLineC: Please enlighten us with your wisdom.

Name: Big Jesus Mordino
Description: Big, sweaty and intimidating, Big Jesus is the owner of the “Desperado” casino and Boss of the Mordino crime family in the city of New Reno, a den of vices, gambling and drugs. He controls the production and distribution of Jet. He likes being called “Mr. Mordino”.
AuditionLineA: I… am Jesus Mordino. You…will address me as SENOR Mordino. (A bead of sweat trickles down his forehead.) What… is your business with me?
AuditionLineB: You have come to… my casino. My home. You have shown me… no respect. You will LEARN.
AuditionLineC: Very well. I… have work for you. Take… (Takes a deep wheezing breath, wipes sweat from his forehead.) …this package... to the *stables* north of Reno.

Name: John Bishop
Description: Head of one of the most powerful crime families in New Reno, Mr. Bishop is a brutal but cunning man. He hopes to bring the “organised” back into “organised crime”, no small feat in a post apocalyptic world. Of the 4 bosses in New Reno he, by far, is the most brutal.
AuditionLineA: You got some balls coming in here.
AuditionLineB: Ol' Tomcat says you're a team player. I need people like that. I got a job for you, if you're interested.
AuditionLineC: If you mess this up or if ANYONE hears about this deal,  and I'm gonna put a knife wound on your body for every chip you asked for.

Name: Christopher Wright
Description: One of Orville’s many sons, Christopher runs the Wright's still operation in New Reno. He tends to have a short temper and go off whenever somebody crosses his family or says bad stuff about it.
AuditionLineA: You ain't heard of Family *Wright?* You musta been out in the desert too long. Family Wright is the biggest crime family in Reno. We're gonna rule this city.
AuditionLineB: Well, now. (He spits on your feet.) Why don't you make yourself useful and lick that up, you piece of dogshit?
AuditionLineC: How do you go to the bathroom with that thing on?

Name: Eldridge
Description: Eldridge is a heavily armed man covered with grease. He is the resident gun-nut of New Reno. He has a massive weapon collection on the walls he's extremely fond of and continuously seeks out ways to expand it. He has incredible knowledge of pre-war weaponry and will upgrade (for a price) The Chosen One’s arsenal.
AuditionLineA: Welcome, traveler… Eldridge's the name. You in the market for some iron to fill that holster of yours?
AuditionLineB: Shooooo-eeee. ::Rubs eyes:: That Power Armor?!
AuditionLineC: Oh...we got us a discrimnatin' customer, eh? Well, at times, some prize pieces do make their way through town...take this, for example. (Holds up something...odd.) Genuine pre-war tech. Innit something?

Name: Ethyl Wright
Description: A pleasantly plump woman with rose cheeks, Ethyl is the matriarch of the Wrights and lives in a world almost entirely of her own making. She’s somehow completely oblivious of her family’s criminal activities.
AuditionLineA: Oh, you poor dear…don't you have a home?
AuditionLineB: New Reno is a beautiful city, but there is SIN here - much of which can be traced back to the evils of alcohol…or as you tribesmen call it… (Pauses dramatically.) …FIREWATER!
AuditionLineC: Why...my goodness! Of all the cheek!

Name: Jagged Jimmy J
Description: One of New Reno’s many chem dealers, Jimmy is a shifty-looking man with a jagged scar running down the side of his face as a result of trying to shave while high on Jet, although he prefers to say that he received the scar in a courageous act of chivalry.
AuditionLineA: Brother, I had my eye on you since you walked down the street. You know what I see? I see a pilot. I see someone who wants to FLY. You just need a little help, a little' JET.
AuditionLineB: Jagged Jimmy J's got a lot of love, my pilot friend, but the world don't always love Jagged Jimmy J back, see?
AuditionLineC: There goes one bad muthuh…and Jimmy J knows a bad muthuh when he sees one.

Name: Jules
Description: Flamboyant and rapacious, Jules is a chem dealer and the self imposed “greeter” of New Reno. A good source of information although not very trustworthy, but in New Reno who is?
AuditionLineA: If you ain't talked to Jules, you don't know HALF of what New Reno gots to offer.
AuditionLineB: Hallelujah! I always KNEW you would be the hero! I KNEW it!
AuditionLineC: Well, now, ANOTHER thing you gotta know about New Reno is nothin's free.

Name: Keith Wright
Description: Thin and blond-haired, Keith Wright is a wary man who takes his job seriously. He clears visitors to his father and ensures that the Wright Estate remains secured.
AuditionLineA: I don't know you, my Dad don't know you, and if you don't start explainin', it ain't gonna matter.
AuditionLineB: You ken go in, but watch out. Dad's in a pissy mood.
AuditionLineC: Get outta here, dimbulb. Next time you talk to me, I'll plug you fulla holes.

Name: Leslie Anne Bishop
Description: Mr. Bishop’s disinterested wife, she’s a sophisticated woman victim of New Reno’s decadent lifestyle. She seems to have lost her lust for life and is in a constant search of satisfaction.
AuditionLineA: You're not terribly bright… However, you do have a certain…charm. Come with me a moment.
AuditionLineB: A simple traveller. How remarkably open and trusting of you. And what, pray tell, do you think I can do for you, "simple traveller?
AuditionLineC: I leave, and my husband will bring me back. The Family watches out for their own, whether they want to be watched or not.

Name: Orville Wright
Description: Head of the Wright crime family, his group has the distinction of being the only real “family” as it comprised of: he, his wife and multitude of sons and daughters. Orville is a passionate man and puts his family before anything, sometimes to his detriment.
AuditionLineA: Come into my house, will you…
AuditionLineB: Now look: You find that son of a bitch who killed my boy, don't you touch 'im…you just come back and TELL me the dead man's name. I'LL take care of it from there.
AuditionLineC: Marriage ain't a word. It's a life sentence.

Name: Marjorie Reed
Description: A cold and calculative woman, Marjorie Reed is the Lead Researcher on chem production for the Mordino crime family. She has little to no empathy for human life as she sees everyone as a potential “test subject”.
AuditionLineA: Why did the slave in the control group kill herself? We weren't even testing her!
AuditionLineB: Oh, I’m not THAT busy…heh…well, no, pretty busy. I mean, mostly its routine drug testing, and occasionally we have a slave go over the edge…
AuditionLineC: Was that some poor attempt at a joke?

Name: T-Ray
Description: Confident and able-bodied, T-Ray is the vain owner of a New Reno automobile repair shop. Despite his cheerful demeanour, he is not somebody you’d want to mess with.
AuditionLineA: DAMN, woman. After I hit those skins, you go off and save the world. That's T-Ray's power for you.
AuditionLineB: Yo, hero. You be sure to tell everyone that T-Ray's your man, aiight?
AuditionLineC: Fast? The Highwayman goes from 0 to 60 in less than a second.

Name: Ariel
Description: Short and slender, Ariel is a young mother residing in Vault 13. Her caravan was attacked by raiders who killed most of the crew, including her husband. She was rescued just in time by the intelligent deathclaws of Vault 13, who now protect her and her daughter.
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Ariel. I don't think I've seen you here before. Who are you?
AuditionLineB: Yes. They provide me with food, water, shelter, and protection. I feel very safe here, and that's more than I could ask for..
AuditionLineC: The raiders, they were incredibly brutal. They killed everyone: men, women, and children. Rand, my husband, died trying to defend Sandy and me.

Name: Goris
Description: Goris is a scholarly Albino Deathclaw, he and his tribe are a rare species who have equal intelligence to humans. He loves reading and trading stories.
AuditionLineA: Yes, I've had some adventures. Say, if you wouldn't mind answering some questions for me, I could tell you some of my adventures in return.
AuditionLineB: It seems this Enclave needed an army and they chose deathclaws because of their ferocity, physical prowess, and... well, you get the picture.
AuditionLineC: Uh huh. Well, your IQ may be smaller than your shoe size, but you obviously have something going for you to have survived in the world this long…

Name: Gruthar
Description: Strong and majestic, Gruthar is the leader of his pack of uniquely intelligent Deathclaws. Despite his frightening appearance he’s a pacifist and only wishes for his tribe to live in peace.
AuditionLineA: Do not fear me, human. I do not intend to harm you. I am Gruthar, leader of this deathclaw pack. Why have you come here?
AuditionLineB: You are no idiot, human. I can see the truth of this in your eyes.
AuditionLineC: It is not our way to kill. I understand that you may not believe me, but I hope that you will judge me by my actions toward you and not out of fear or prejudice.

Name: Joseph
Description: Joseph is a herbalist who serves as the doctor for the residents of Vault 13, namely the deathclaws which inhabit it. From his time among them, he has become very knowledgeable about their species.
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Joseph the herbalist. What can I help you with?
AuditionLineB: Why, certainly. Hmmm. You'll need to take some of this. I'll apply this balm to the wound. Now just lie back and rest for a couple of hours.
AuditionLineC: No, I'm not a prisoner. I stay because I'm needed here.

Name: Vice President Bird
Description: Daniel Bird is the Vice President of the Enclave but an experiment gone wrong took a toll on his mental faculties leaving him in a permanent state of mumbling to himself and talking in circles.
AuditionLineA: Hmm, tell me, how do you spell potato? With an 'E,' or without?
AuditionLineB: Carry on, trooper. The future will be better tomorrow.
AuditionLineC: That's not true, Republicans understand the importance of bondage between a mother and child. That's the key to the solution of all our problems-we need a return to family values.

Name: Charles Curling
Description: Lieutenant Colonel Doctor Charles Curling is the head of the United States Chemical Corps stationed on the Enclave Oil Rig base. He’s the lead researcher on the Enclave’s project to eradicate all mutant life, which includes regular wastelanders.
AuditionLineA: Interesting. I didn't realize that the toxin made them dumber.
AuditionLineB: In order to make the United States safe for humanity, all of the mutants must first be exterminated.
AuditionLineC: Isn't it obvious, my mutated friend? The F.E.V. is, thanks to me, a lethal toxin.

Name: Sergeant Granite
Description: Granite commands the Enclave Control Company, a specialized unit usually assigned to perimeter defense. Despite his loyalty to the Enclave, recent events may challenge his beliefs.
AuditionLineA: Lock and load. Let's go!
AuditionLineB: Now, just what the hell are you doing here?
AuditionLineC: Gee, you've got me shaking in my boots. Shut up.

Name: Mayor Ascorti
Description: Characterised by his slicked back hair and friendly smile, Ascorti is the mayor of the mining settlement of Redding and owner of its decadent casino named after him. A greedy man who’ll do anything for a profit.
AuditionLineA: Everyone's an Ace here at Ascorti's! I'm Ascorti, proprietor and mayor of this fine town.
AuditionLineB: I can sell it to you for only $1,000. Special offer; just your luck to hit me on a generous day like this.
AuditionLineC: If you're here to try your luck, you're welcome.

Name: Painless Doc Johnson
Description: Originally from Vault City, Doc Johnson is the nervous and slightly sadistic doctor of Redding.
AuditionLineA: You have a very well developed sagittal crest.
AuditionLineB: Got yourself all scraped up, huh? Well, let Doc Johnson take a look at that. Easy now, I'm a professional.
AuditionLineC: Wouldn't let that go too long. Some wounds fester and start oozing puss. Then there's always gangrene. Course, lately, I haven't used my knives as much as I'd like. Getting a bit rusty. Tell you what: Go ahead and let it go as long as you want. Maybe I can get some practice later on.

Name: Fannie Mae
Description: Showing more wear from mileage than from years, Fannie Mae is a prostitute working at Lou’s “Malamute Saloon”. She has a crippling dependence to Jet (a deadly drug) and has no scruples tricking the dim-witted into fueling her addiction.
AuditionLineA: Fannie don't flop for no morons.
AuditionLineB: Hey there, lover. I'm feeling a little under the weather lately. Want to give me some money for a quick boost?
AuditionLineC: Jet's the only thing that makes me fly. ./~Come fly with me ./~ Give me a little something special, won'tcha?

Name: Louise
Description: Usually referred to as “Lou”, she’s the hearty owner of the “Malamute Saloon”. A woman who has seen much in her years, it takes little to faze her.
AuditionLineA: Remember what I said. Too much money ain't good for that gal. Now whattya need?
AuditionLineB: Well, I hear all kinds of things about the whole city bein' full o' nuthin' but crazy followers of some kind of kooky religion.
AuditionLineC: You're just an idjit, ain't ya?

Name: Marge LeBarge
Description: Burly and commanding, Marge LeBarge isn’t a woman you’d want to mess with. She’s the owner of Redding’s “Kokoweef Gold Mine”. She’s fairly amicable to anyone on her good side.
AuditionLineA: Looks like your belt doesn't go through all the loops.
AuditionLineB: A Garden of Eden Creation Kit, huh? Sounds pretty impressive. If I had something like that you sure wouldn't find me grubbing around in the dirt to make ends meet, now would you?
AuditionLineC: It's got kind of a romantic sound to it, don't it? Ko-ko-weef. Yeah, I still like the way that sounds.

Name: Doctor Jubilee
Description: Jubilee is an old, kindly looking fellow and a certified doctor working for the New California Republic. He’s a well respected doctor, despite the fact that he constantly suggests “amputating the leg” as a solution to any patients’ ailments.
AuditionLineA: I'm Doc Jubilee. What's wrong, young man?
AuditionLineB: I don't know. Don't think I can save it. We may have to cut that leg off.
AuditionLineC: Put that back! You could seriously hurt yourself with that stuff.

Name: Ranger Chief Elise
Description: Young but experienced, Elise is the leader of the NCR Rangers: a paramilitary group focused on eradicating the Slavers that plague the California Wasteland. A no-nonsense woman with a good sense of justice.
AuditionLineA: I'm Elise. That's Gond. We're members of a 'group' that's trying to do right for folks.
AuditionLineB: Not so fast. You need to pass a test before becoming a ranger.
AuditionLineC: Don't bullshit me. I can see what kind of person you are.

Name: Enlightened One
Description: The Enlightened One is the Hubology (a new wave religion) emissary in NCR. She tends to make people uneasy with her constant smile on her face. Her proselytising seems to have angered a few citizens.
AuditionLineA: Greetings, child. Are you one of the Enlightened?
AuditionLineB: Ah, such enthusiasm. Come with me.
AuditionLineC: Honestly, how do they expect me to spread the word out here when they don't even keep me up-to-date on the latest doctrine!?

Name: Merk
Description: Merk is the local crime boss of NCR, which is an achievement in itself due to the town being close to a police state. Only someone who is respected in the underground may earn a meeting with him.
AuditionLineA: Go fetch me another whiskey - quick now.
AuditionLineB: Will somebody get this brahmin turd out of here?
AuditionLineC: I’ve got a job for you…

Name: Robodog
Description: A poorly made half dog/half machine, Robodog is a simple minded but loyal companion to the Chosen One.
AuditionLineA: Arf! <click> Woof!
AuditionLineB: <sprzzzt> Meow...error.
AuditionLineC: <whirrr> Not bird, nor plane, nor even frog, just lil' old me - Robodog!<click>

Name: Sheriff Dumont
Description: Grey haired and square jawed, Dumont is the sheriff and chief of the NCR Police Force. A stoic man who takes his job very seriously.
AuditionLineA: Take a word of advice from Sheriff Dumont, stranger - this town don't care for your kind. Any trouble and I come down hard. Now, is there anything I can do for you?
AuditionLineB: Recommend you? Hmmm....I couldn't. Don't even know you.
AuditionLineC: Just make sure things stay that way. Goodbye.

Name: Vortis
Description: Vortis is an old and cunning Slaver who operates in the NCR Bazaar.
AuditionLineA: This place is my place and I, Vortis, run an honest and legitimate business no matter what anybody in NCR tells you.
AuditionLineB: Oh, look - the goody two-shoes, lollipop kid. Boys, escort this hypocritical paragon of saintly virtue out of my sight!
AuditionLineC: Go in there and I'll blow your head off. Understand?

Name: Don
Description: Don is a ruthless slaver, subordinate to Metzger and leader of the Slaver’s Camp south west of The Den.
AuditionLineA: Hey, what the fuck!? Who the hell are you?
AuditionLineB: Join us? This aint a fuckin recruiting center. If you want to join the slavers go to the Den and speak with Metzger.
AuditionLineC: Yeah right. You're full of shit and you're wasting my time. For that, you die. [Signals to his men.] Let's waste this loser.

Name: Krom
Description: Initially hailing from a different tribe, Krom was asked to become Umbra’s chief warrior due to his amazing prowess in battle and unmatched bravery.
AuditionLineA: I come from a tribe far to the north. When I was fifteen, we were attacked by savages. I awoke that day as a boy, but by the time the sun set on that grim scene, I had slayed my way to manhood.
AuditionLineB: What's life without battle and strife? It either breaks a man, or it forges him into steel. I wear my scars with pride.
AuditionLineC: You've got a fire in you, girl. I like that. Perhaps we could put that fire to good use while you're here. What do you say?

Name: Chieftain
Description: A man of few words, the chieftain of Umbra Tribe (Sulik’s clan) will do what is best for his people.
AuditionLineA: The Holy GECK... [He takes a long hit off his pipe.] There is a creature that we sometimes hunt -- sometimes, it hunts us. A gecko. No, I sense that's not what you seek.
AuditionLineB: The slavers are led by a man with a dark soul. Metzger. He dwells in one of the ruined husks of the Old One's cities. They call it the Den.
AuditionLineC: You have done a great deed, child. I hear the cries of many wicked bonespirits lost out in the Great Salt Water.

Name: Kurisu
Description: A young member of the tribe, Kurisu is Sulik’s sister. She is currently captured by slavers. It’ll be up to The Chosen One to free her and reunite her with her brother.
AuditionLineA: Name's Kurisu, but now not the time for proper greetin'. Please, you needin' to get us out of cage and away from de wicked men.
AuditionLineB: Thanks again, fren. May the spirits bless you.
AuditionLineC: It be safe yet? You sent the slavers to the spirits?

Name: Amanda
Description: Amanda is a tired-looking woman. Her husband, Joshua, was recently arrested for striking a Citizen during a bar brawl at the Spittoon. As a result, he was sentenced to servant work as rehabilitation. Amanda is looking at years of raising her son alone, possibly losing her meager tent in the Courtyard, as Joshua was the breadwinner of the family.
AuditionLineA: I...well, I...it's my husband Joshua. He...got into some trouble in...the bar. He accidentally struck a Citizen and was arrested. He didn't mean to, but he'd been drinking, and…
AuditionLineB: Please rescue Joshua. He's inside the City in the Servant Allocation Center.
AuditionLineC: Thank you again for rescuing my husband. We'll be moving on soon.

Name: Doctor Andrew
Description: Andrew is more or less an average citizen left in charge of a malfunctioning Auto-Doc just outside of Vault City. He has received very little, if any, medical training, and will make that known in conversation.
AuditionLineA: Whoa...looks like you've seen some serious action, friend.
AuditionLineB: Uh-oh. Looks like the ol' Doctor took a pound of flesh this time.
AuditionLineC: Pay you? Hell, no! I didn't ask you to fix it, so you don't get jack.

Name: Connar
Description: Connar is the leader of a farming village near Vault City. He hopes to protect his people from their tyranny.
AuditionLineA: Those creatures are the only thing that are stopping Vault City from making us their so-called servants.
AuditionLineB: You idiot! Why the hell did you do that!
AuditionLineC: Stay where you are for now, wanderer. What are you doing here?

Name: Lydia
Description: Dressed in fatigues and metal armor, Lydia would fit right in with Vault City guardsmen, but she prefers running her bar and serving those who come to the city. Like most citizens she has some closed minded views although she is friendlier than most.
AuditionLineA: Please! Take a seat, rest for a while!
AuditionLineB: The brahmin milk's not on tap...well, not exactly. I'd have to go out and snag some really quick.
AuditionLineC: That is perhaps the most fascinating thing I've ever heard. Hold on a second...I want the guards to hear it, too.

Name: Happy Harry
Description: A short and jovial man, Happy Harry runs a small store in Vault City’s courtyard. He seems to supply all kinds of things.
AuditionLineA: Well, hello there... what can I do for you?
AuditionLineB: Working with Dave, eh? Yeah, I know the fella. I see he's still got a knack for getting others to do his leg work--lazy bastard.
AuditionLineC: Not my problem. Look, my business struggles enough as it is. If anyone finds out I'm providing Connar with weapons, then things will turn real ugly, real fast.

Name: Thomas Moore
Description: A scruffy looking man (albeit wearing clean clothes), Thomas Moore can be found in the streets of Vault City loudly preaching for the abolition of slavery. In reality, Thomas Moore is an undercover NCR agent gathering intelligence on Vault City and smuggling its technology outside.
AuditionLineA: Hello and welcome, traveler! Have you heard the word today?
AuditionLineB: It is TIME to hear the wailing of our kin outside these walls and let them in! We have more than enough to feed and shelter our brothers... we need not be rich when so MANY are poor.
AuditionLineC: I have a briefcase... with information vital to our cause. Will you deliver it to New Reno for me? I would do it, but the Citizens here are watching me...

Name: Phyllis
Description: Phyllis is the young assistant of Dr. Troy and, to no one’s surprise, another example of Vault City snobbery. She seems curious about life outside the city walls.
AuditionLineA: Oh! You must be one of the Servants assigned here for the day.
AuditionLineB: Vault City? Well, actually, there's not much to say. I mean, I've been a Citizen all my life…
AuditionLineC: It's like they're all... clones. They all dress alike, act alike, and the worst part is that everybody seems happy with it.

Name: Old Joe
Description: An ancient looking man with a wild gleam to his eyes, Old Joe is known as the local “crazy old man”. There may be more to him than it seems.
AuditionLineA: Don't remember me, do you? Well, you do seem to be a bit young.
AuditionLineB: Let an old man rest.
AuditionLineC: Connar, huh? He's a good guy. I've been keeping my eye on things for him.

Name: Ann
Description: Ann is Connar’s young and laborious wife, she hopes to turn her village into a proper settlement.
AuditionLineA: Why hello there, I'm Connar's wife, Ann. You must be the one who helped us out. I can't tell you how much we appreciate all you've done.
AuditionLineB: Oh, it's you! Thank you for speaking with Mr. Baron.
AuditionLineC: We'll stifle as a community without proper trade.

Name: Private Dobbs
Description: Dobbs is a soldier of the United States Army. Sometime before October 23, 2077, he was killed in battle and pronounced dead, and he claims to have learned this via an out-of-body experience. While he was out of the body he observed his body being taken to a laboratory and immersed in bio med gel. When defrosted he looks healthy, but seems quite disoriented.
AuditionLineA: I-I'm Dobbs, Private, First Class.
AuditionLineB: I was in a battle. Yes, a battle. There was gunfire and explosions everywhere. People dying. I was scared but I had to keep on fighting. Then there was this blinding flash.
AuditionLineC: The next thing I remember was seeing my body as if I was looking down at it from above. I heard the doctors say I was dead and then they threw my body onto a pile of other bodies.
